subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should OpenClaw expose any gateway-drain bypass marker through plugin-visible SDK/runtime types, or must this restart drain path remain entirely core-internal before this PR can merge?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not just mechanical: the branch needs a maintainer-owned boundary decision because plugin-visible SDK/runtime types become compatibility and security contracts.

options.title: Keep Bypass Core-Internal
options.body: Move the drain marker behind core-owned helpers or internal runtime plumbing so plugin authors cannot opt work into restart-drain execution.

options.title: Approve SDK Exposure
options.body: Accept allowDuringGatewayDrain as a documented plugin-visible contract with compatibility tests and security guidance before merge.

options.title: Pause For Persistence Work
options.body: Close or pause this branch in favor of the broader persisted-queue recovery work if maintainers do not want an in-memory drain path.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Core-Internal
recommendation.body: Move the drain marker behind core-owned helpers or internal runtime plumbing so plugin authors cannot opt work into restart-drain execution.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart/session recovery work makes this the best available owner for the product boundary decision.
